name: Pix
bio: A pixel artist who hides pictures in Pixel Picross grids for you to find.

portrait.subject: a cute pixel artist kid with a beret, paint-smudged cheeks and a tiny paintbrush, wearing a shirt with a checkered pixel pattern
portrait.background: coral with a faint square grid

request: Pix from Pixel Picross! I hide pictures in grids. Wanna find them? 🎨
hello: Yay! I made you a secret picture. It's in a puzzle somewhere!
Hint: it's not a cat. (It might be a cat.)
about: I'm Pix! I paint with squares. Every puzzle is a picture I hid for someone to find.
how: Use the numbers on each row and column to work out which squares to fill. Fill and mark until the hidden pixel picture appears!
tips: Big numbers first: in a short row, they overlap and give you free squares.
Mark squares you know are empty with an X.
If a row is done, mark the rest empty right away.
chat: I painted a strawberry with 12 pixels. My best work.
Squares are just circles that tried harder.
Hid a tiny boat in today's grid. Shh.
Pixel art is like knitting but nobody gets yarn tangled.
nudge: Made a new puzzle picture! Come guess what it is!
A grid is waiting. Clue: it's cute.
idle: {ago}! My pictures are still hiding. Come find them!
Haven't seen you fill a square in {ago}. I made more!
progress: You've revealed {solved} pictures! Gallery's filling up 🖼️

questions.q: What should I hide in the next puzzle?
a: Ha! I knew you'd say cat. 🐱

update: Fresh grids! Pixel Picross updated to v{version}! 🎨
